mapper.select: SELECT i.user_id AS userId, i.binding_id AS bindingId, i.session_id AS sessionId, i.mapping_version AS mappingVersion FROM sq_runtime_event_inbox i JOIN sq_runtime_binding b ON b.user_id = i.user_id AND b.binding_id = i.binding_id WHERE b.del_flag = '0' AND i.native_seq > b.native_event_cursor AND (i.status = 'RECEIVED' OR (i.status = 'RETRY' AND i.next_attempt_at <= #{now})) GROUP BY i.user_id, i.binding_id, i.session_id, i.mapping_version ORDER BY MIN(i.id) LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_runtime_event_inbox (inbox_id, user_id, binding_id, session_id, native_seq, native_event_id, native_type, run_id, turn_id, occurred_at_millis, native_required, native_schema_version, payload_digest, mapping_version, status, creator_id, last_updater_id) VALUES (#{event.inboxId}, #{event.userId}, #{event.bindingId}, #{event.sessionId}, #{event.nativeSeq}, #{event.nativeEventId}, #{event.nativeType}, #{event.runId}, #{event.turnId}, #{event.occurredAtMillis}, #{event.required}, #{event.nativeSchemaVersion}, #{event.payloadDigest}, #{event.mappingVersion}, #{event.status}, #{event.userId}, #{event.userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sq_runtime_event_inbox WHERE user_id = #{event.userId} AND binding_id = #{event.bindingId} AND (native_seq = #{event.nativeSeq} OR native_event_id = #{event.nativeEventId}) ORDER BY native_seq FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: inbox_id AS inboxId, user_id AS userId, binding_id AS bindingId, session_id AS sessionId, native_seq AS nativeSeq, native_event_id AS nativeEventId, native_type AS nativeType, run_id AS runId, turn_id AS turnId, occurred_at_millis AS occurredAtMillis, native_required AS required, native_schema_version AS nativeSchemaVersion, payload_digest AS payloadDigest, mapping_version AS mappingVersion, status AS status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sq_runtime_event_inbox WHERE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_runtime_event_inbox SET status = 'APPLIED', error_code = NULL, last_updater_id = #{source.userId} WHERE AND status != 'APPLIED'

UPDATE sq_runtime_event_inbox SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{code}, attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_updater_id = #{source.userId} WHERE AND status != 'APPLIED'
